sections.heading: Vehicle safety reporting, equipment and tires
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Vehicle safety reporting, equipment and tires

FACT_ID: sec06-R01 | anchor: A38
A tire may lose as much as one pound per square inch of pressure over a month. [A38]
Source: [A38 -> pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec06-R02 | anchor: A38
Check pressure in every tire, including the spare, monthly or before a long trip. [A38]
Source: [A38 -> pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec06-R03 | anchor: A38
Use a dependable pressure gauge when checking inflation. [A38]
Source: [A38 -> pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec06-R04 | anchor: A38
A label inside the vehicle's door opening normally gives the recommended pressure. [A38]
Source: [A38 -> pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec06-R05 | anchor: A38
Measure tire pressure before driving or after the vehicle has stood for at least three hours following a drive. [A38]
Source: [A38 -> pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec06-R06 | anchor: A38
Insert the gauge into the tire's valve stem to obtain a pressure reading. [A38]
Source: [A38 -> pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec06-R07 | anchor: A38
The small air escape during a reading normally has little effect, unless the gauge is held down too long. [A38]
Source: [A38 -> pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec06-R08 | anchor: A38
Compare the reading with the vehicle's door-label recommendation or owner's manual, rather than the tire-sidewall pressure. [A38]
Source: [A38 -> pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec06-R09 | anchor: A38
If measured pressure is too high, release air to the recommended level; if too low, add air or obtain retailer help. [A38]
Source: [A38 -> pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec06-R10 | anchor: A38
Inspect tires for damage and wear monthly or before a lengthy road trip. [A38]
Source: [A38 -> pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec06-R11 | anchor: A38
For the handbook's penny check, hold Lincoln's body between thumb and forefinger and insert his head into a groove where tread appears lowest. [A38]
Source: [A38 -> pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec06-R12 | anchor: A38
The handbook's penny comparison looks for tread covering part of Lincoln's head. [A38]
Source: [A38 -> pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec06-R13 | anchor: A38
The text warns that tread below its penny-test comparison greatly reduces grip in adverse conditions. [A38]
Source: [A38 -> pdf-0038]
